name: opencollab
description: Monorepo de OpenCollab: desktop (Tauri), server (NestJS) y web (Vite). El core Rust vive en crates/ y se maneja con Cargo.

scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace
scripts.pre-push: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm check:rust
